scope: Production QuantizedCosineVector, its Companion, VectorizedByteDotProduct, and a small Java scoring probe; Kotlin stdlib and annotations provided as library dependencies.

checks.check: D8 release dexing against Android API 35
R8 release shrinking against Android API 35 with embedded consumer rules
R8 release shrinking with minification, access modification and repackaging

checks.expected: Removing META-INF/proguard/onyx-vector.pro causes R8 compilation to fail on eight missing jdk.incubator.vector classes.

checks.details: Field descriptors, method descriptors, and instruction type/member references were parsed from D8 and both R8 DEX outputs. No JDK Vector API type references were present in QuantizedCosineVector, its Companion, or the probe. All remained in VectorizedByteDotProduct.

checks.check: R8 optimized JVM classfile fallback without Vector API module
checks.library: java.base only, plus Kotlin stdlib and JetBrains annotations
checks.score_comparison: Exact Float.floatToIntBits equality with legacy scalar cosine

command_templates.d8: java -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1 -Xmx512m -cp r8.jar com.android.tools.r8.D8 --release --thread-count 1 --output d8-dex.jar --lib android.jar --lib kotlin-stdlib-2.2.10.jar --min-api 26 input.jar
command_templates.r8: java -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1 -Xmx512m -cp r8.jar com.android.tools.r8.R8 --release --thread-count 1 --output r8-dex.jar --lib android.jar --lib kotlin-stdlib-2.2.10.jar --lib annotations-13.0.jar --pg-conf keep.pro --no-minification --min-api 26 input.jar
command_templates.r8_minified: java -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1 -Xmx512m -cp r8.jar com.android.tools.r8.R8 --release --thread-count 1 --output r8-minified-dex.jar --lib android.jar --lib kotlin-stdlib-2.2.10.jar --lib annotations-13.0.jar --pg-conf minified.pro --min-api 26 input.jar
command_templates.keep.pro: -keep class CosineAndroidProbe { public static void main(java.lang.String[]); }

limitations: No Android device, emulator, or ART execution was performed.
Validation covers the isolated vector implementation and its D8/R8 packaging, not Android compatibility of the complete database or every Android/R8 version.
